summary_markdown:
The Analytics v2023.8.3 update was announced, detailing several key changes and improvements.

Key updates include:
* Significant performance improvement on the Traffic Dashboard.
* The default time period for all Dashboards has been shifted back one day to prevent displaying unreliable current data.
* Number format localization is now supported according to client locales.
* Various cosmetic, translation, and behavioral fixes were implemented based on user feedback.
* Improvements were made across Campaigns and Inventory sections.
